title: PolicyPortal.Rating: .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10
scenario: Corvane's agent portal is moving from .NET Framework 4.8 on Windows to .NET 10 on Linux, one library at a time. The shared rating library is first. It does not build outside Windows, and underwriting insists that no premium changes by a cent.
task: Convert the classic csproj and packages.config to an SDK-style net10.0 project
Make the production settings load under any host, not only from App.config
Replace the BinaryFormatter quote cache with System.Text.Json in the agreed format
Fix note parsing that breaks on CRLF under ICU string comparison
acceptance: Hidden tests: production settings and premiums, CRLF and mixed-ending notes, the cache fixture, round trip and legacy entries
ANSWER.md maps each fix to its .NET breaking change

practices.label: Week 5 Mon - porting from .NET Framework: project format
Week 5 Tue - what breaks: BinaryFormatter, ICU, configuration
